description: Narrate what the account still needs to go live: an ordered ladder of steps (create the wallet, verify WhatsApp, deposit+convert+withdraw to verify, create the store), each with a plain PT+EN title and instruction to relay to the human, an absolute app deep link, and the current numbers. Composes the verification progress with a store probe, and — when every step is complete — triggers verification itself so the account never sits 'all green but not verified'. Read-first; the only write is that self-heal trigger. Every incomplete step is a HUMAN step: relay its instruction and deep link to the operator and wait — no tool here can complete one for them.
name: get_onboarding_status

merchant_exists.description: Whether a merchant/store profile exists on this account yet.

next_step.description: The id of the first step still to do (or 'ready' when the account is fully set up).

self_healed.description: true when this call auto-triggered POST /api/verification because every step was complete.

steps.description: The ordered onboarding ladder — the agent narrates it top to bottom.

app_url.description: Absolute deep link into the app for this step, or null.

id.description: Stable step id (e.g. wallet, whatsapp, deposit, convert_lbtc, withdraw, verification, merchant, or __unknown).

instruction.description: What the human should do, in plain language (PT+EN), to relay.

en.description: English text to relay to the human.

pt.description: Portuguese text to relay to the human.

numbers.description: The step's numeric targets/remaining, when it has any.

state.description: done = complete; pending = to do; unknown = the server cannot see it from here (do it in the app).

title.description: Short human title for the step (PT+EN), to relay.

en.description: English text to relay to the human.

pt.description: Portuguese text to relay to the human.

verification_enabled.description: Whether the verification program is enabled at all. false → nothing to complete right now.

verified.description: Whether the account is verified (can create a store and go live).

title: Get onboarding status
